data.body: [P2] Avoid comparing the timer's service timestamp with the SDK clock. This externally completed wait uses a service completion timestamp, while `otel-after-wait` starts on the resumed SDK clock. Clock skew can therefore make this `before` assertion and the reciprocal `after` fail despite correct completion ordering and Invocation-2 links—the same issue addressed by the new case-25/26 skew tests. Remove both cross-clock comparisons, assert `WaitSucceeded` before the subsequent step in execution history, and add an equivalent skew regression for case 21.
